locator.section: 8.x Proton-bound complexes in CI: protonated phenyl 3-butenyl ether

evidence.curator_note: The book (eq 8.15) DRAWS a proton-bound complex [PhO...H...butadiene] as the intermediate from the methane-CI [M+H]+ ion of phenyl 3-butenyl ether; the non-covalent complex is NOT separately encoded (partial bonds not RDKit-representable) - this record encodes the net rH reaction precursor->but-2-enyl cation (76%). 0 electron-pushing arcs drawn (only 'rH' reaction arrows). Equation 8.15, branch giving protonated butadiene (drawn as H3C-CH=CH-CH2+ and labelled 76% on the page). Same precursor (protonated phenyl 3-butenyl ether, MH+ from methane CI) and same rH to the proton-bound complex [phenol...H+...butadiene] as branch 8.15a, but here the shared proton stays on the butadiene (PA 8.4 eV) -> neutral phenol + protonated butadiene, the resonance-stabilised but-2-enyl (1-methylallyl) cation C4H7+ (m/z 55). INTERMEDIATE OMITTED (non-covalent proton-bound complex): encoded as the NET rearrangement in one formal-arrow step. RESONANCE: the C4H7+ product is allylic, CH3-CH=CH-CH2+ <-> CH3-CH+-CH=CH2; I encode the single localised Kekule form the page draws (cation on C9, C10=C11 double bond, CH3 at C12). Book draws 0 electron-pushing arcs; all three encoded moves are reconstructed for electron balance (not drawn on the page): move <1> is a heterolytic O7-C9 cleavage taking that bonding pair onto O7 (neutralising the oxonium to neutral phenol and leaving C9 as the primary cation), moves <2> and <3> perform the allylic H-relay that delivers the beta H (H20) from C10 to the terminal C12 while shifting the C11=C12 pi bond to C10=C11 -- net, H20 migrates C10 -> C12 and the double bond walks, giving the but-2-enyl cation drawn in the book. Closed-shell throughout. Migrating H written as isotope-tagged [1H:20] so RDKit preserves its map.

NO MOD rule is cross-linked: rule_index by_equation['8.15'] is null. The 'Gl. 8.15' comment in src/data_generation/rules/IMS_chap8_examples.py has no Rule.fromDFS beneath it. rule_mismatches: none (nothing to compare against).

Book prints '76%' under the protonated-butadiene product. observed_mz 55.0537 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of the but-2-enyl cation C4H7+ (electron-mass corrected); the page prints the relative abundance (76% -> relative_intensity 0.76) but no m/z.
